

Field
Description
AccountId
The account ID of the corresponding cloud provider
PolicyId
The ID of the associated policy
PolicyStatement
The statement of the associated policy
CloudProvider
The name of cloud provider
CloudService
The name of cloud service associated with the detection
Severity
The severity score associated with the event
SeverityName
The severity level of the detection, as a string (High/Medium/Informational)
EventAction
The name of the event action
EventSource
The source of the event
EventCreatedTimestamp
Time the event happened
UserId
The ID of the user that performed the operation. For example, a person who logged in to an account.
UserName
The name of the user that performed the operation
UserSourceIp
The IP address of user endpoint that performs the operation
Tactic
The name of the tactic associated with the behavior
Technique
The name of the technique/sub-technique associated with the behavior
